changeRecord.title: load sign flipped
changeRecord.target: load 0 of case L (memberDistributed on BXA1.1)
changeRecord.whyItMatters: Loads are signed along the positive axes: gravity on a model with Z up is a negative Z value. A load with the wrong sign acts upwards or to the other side; in combination with the other loads it relieves where it should add, so the governing forces, the governing combination and even the sign of the reactions (uplift) change.
changeRecord.precondition: a nodal load, member load or imposed support displacement
